Saudi Arabia Public Holidays and Holiday Work Pay

The next holiday is shown first; then calculate what you are owed if you work on a holiday.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Pay for working on a public holiday

Basic plus allowances.

Public holidays in Saudi Arabia: 2026 and 2027

HolidayDaysRest of 20262027
Founding Day1 day—Mon 22 Feb
Eid al-Fitr4 days—Tue 9 Mar – Fri 12 Mar · expected
Eid al-Adha (from Arafat Day)4 days—Sat 15 May – Tue 18 May (or Sun 16 May – Wed 19 May) · expected
National Day1 day—Thu 23 Sept

Pay for working on a holiday

All hours worked on holidays and Eids count as overtime (Article 107(3)), paid at the actual hourly wage plus 50% of the basic hourly wage on top of the holiday pay already in your salary. With the worker's consent, paid compensatory leave of at least an hour and a half per hour can replace the cash. We calculate the hourly wage as monthly pay ÷ 30 ÷ 8.

Example: basic SAR 6,000 and actual SAR 8,000, working 8 hours on Eid: 8,000 ÷ 240 = 33.33, and 50% × 6,000 ÷ 240 = 12.50, so each hour is 45.83 and you are owed SAR 366.67.

Holidays that fall on the weekly rest day

The worker gets a similar day before or after it (Article 24 of the regulations), so if the Eid al-Fitr 2027 holiday includes Friday 12 March, a day in lieu is due. National Day or Founding Day inside an Eid holiday is not compensated. A holiday inside annual leave extends the leave by the same number of days.

Government sector

Civil servants have much longer holidays (about two weeks for each Eid), and Labour Law employees of government bodies get 4 to 5 working days per Eid under Council of Ministers Resolution 532. No private-sector public holidays remain in 2026.

Eid dates are expected dates by the Umm al-Qura calendar; the Ministry of Human Resources announces them before each Eid.

Frequently asked questions

How many days is the Eid al-Fitr holiday for the private sector?

4 days starting the day after 29 Ramadan by the Umm al-Qura calendar (Article 24 of the Executive Regulations). In 2027 it is expected from Tuesday 9 to Friday 12 March, with a day in lieu of the Friday before or after.

How many days is the Eid al-Adha holiday?

4 days starting on Arafat Day: expected from Saturday 15 to Tuesday 18 May 2027, or 16–19 May if Arafat is declared on Sunday.

Is Founding Day a holiday for the private sector?

Yes, one day on 22 February since the regulations were amended in 2022; in 2027 it falls on Monday 22 February.

How much is pay for working on Eid in Saudi Arabia?

All hours worked on holidays and Eids are overtime (Article 107): the actual hourly wage + 50% of the basic hourly wage, on top of holiday pay. Example: basic SAR 6,000, actual SAR 8,000 and 8 hours = SAR 366.67, or compensatory leave with the worker's consent.

What if a holiday falls on the weekly rest day?

The worker gets a similar day before or after it (Article 24), except that National Day or Founding Day falling inside an Eid holiday is not compensated.

How long are Eid holidays for government employees?

Much longer: the Eid al-Fitr 1447 holiday for civil servants was about 13 days. Employees of government bodies under the Labour Law get 4 to 5 working days for each Eid (Council of Ministers Resolution 532).
